lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters; pixel density increases while centroid diameter decreases significantly as the features progress towards the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming distinct grid-like nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-luminance fusiform features are attached to the shark: one trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin and one located at the ventral-lateral pectoral base.
